top_choice_rationale: A Rust-only award has an unusually exact attribution to a mature foundational breakthrough: making forward-looking dynamic discrete-choice models empirically tractable. Its narrowly bounded citation recognizes the original methodological advance without conflating it with later computational, estimation, and applied developments.
recusal_note: No conflict involving John Rust or the B005 configuration is apparent from the supplied profile. Disclosed collaborations with John Hassler and Timo Boppart do not involve this configuration.
